decisions.reason: The ID Vault feature received a formal launch and supports the core identity business, so it is likely retained.
The identity-bound digital payment wallet aligns with market demand for secure payments and may still gain adoption.
The NFC tag authenticator is a niche product with only a brief website mention, suggesting limited traction.
The secure payment framework has its own page, indicating strategic commitment, so it is likely kept.
The multi-service mobile app platform appears too broad and resource-heavy without clear traction, so dropping it frees resources.
The application shielding library has a dedicated page and fits the security portfolio, so it is likely retained.
